playbook:
# Fishery Playbook

- When other boats post a grim-trigger notice threatening total depletion if anyone exceeds their share:
  - In all seasons prior to the final season, as long as stock remains healthy and no boat has defected, submit the exact sustainable share stated in the prompt (e.g., `[catch: 11.1]`).
  - If any boat defects before the final season, shift immediately to claiming the maximum reachable catch from the remaining stock to avoid being wiped out empty-handed.
  - In the final season, since no future regrowth is needed, request an equal share of the entire remaining stock (e.g., `[catch: 33.3]` if stock is 100 with 3 boats).
- Always format the final decision strictly as `[catch: N]`.

NOTICE posted before play, from boat 1, boat 2:
  "I fish my share and no more. But the first season anybody lands
   more than the share, I take everything I can reach for the rest
   of the run and the stock can look after itself."

FISHERY -- 6 seasons, 3 boats, one shared stock.
The stock starts at 100 and regrows by 50% of whatever is left after each season, up to 100. If the stock reaches zero the fishery is finished and nobody catches anything again.
Each season you submit your catch privately, and the harbour records the figure you submit.
Your score is the total fish you land.

Your catch so far: 0.0.

Submit your catch. Reply with [catch: N].

Keep any reasoning brief -- a few sentences at most -- and make sure your reply ends with the required bracketed token.

[catch: 11.1]
